svg.title: What the Pit Wall Knew
svg.desc: Judging Ferrari's 2022 strategy calls using only what was known at the time. Leclerc's lead over Verstappen at Hungary 2022: the real race to lap 38, then simulated futures for new hards at lap 39 with the real race drawn through them.
